tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Reads the public homepage of a domain, finds its Google Tag Manager and Google tag container IDs, loads those containers from googletagmanager.com and scores the conversion setup from 0 to 100 (grade A to F). Findings include Google Ads conversions that fire on every page load, on plain page views,

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Returns aggregate counts from scans run on fireshift.ai and through this server: total scans, distinct sites, scans in the last 7 days, the most common findings in the last 7 days with their share of scored sites, and the grade mix. Never returns domain names. Updated every 5 minutes.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "scan_site" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
